headline: Retailer David Jones to Close Three Stores in Perth Amid CBD Uncertainty
summary: Department store chain David Jones is preparing to shut down at least three retail locations in Perth, Western Australia, highlighting structural pressures on central business district brick-and-mortar retail.
why: David Jones is one of Australia's premier department store operators; store closures reflect shifts in urban commercial real estate and retail foot traffic.

impacts.name: David Jones
impacts.why: Closing multiple metropolitan branch locations signals declining sales volume or unviable commercial leases.
